desc: The Bushnell AR Optic scope features our illuminated BTR reticle for fast and accurate target acquisition. To speed up switching between magnification we've given you two Throw Down Power Change Levers of different lengths. The 6 mil per revolution turrets are capped to protect them from bumps and hard use. Features a 30mm tube, IPX7 Waterproof construction and fully multi coated optics.
